notes.text:
Retain k algebraically closed, trivially valued and characteristic zero, and X smooth connected projective. BJ's genuine PSH(c1(L)) uses decreasing generically finite section maxima on actual rational bundles whose numerical classes approach c1(L). Common base loci and −∞ values are allowed; no section-algebra finite generation is assumed.

Boucksom–Jonsson, arXiv:2206.07183v2, submitted 6 September 2023 and PDF dated 7 September 2023, Theorem A proves the envelope property for EVERY numerical class on smooth projective X when char(k)=0 or dim(X)≤2. Corollaries 2.1–2.2 give PSH(theta)≠∅ exactly for pseudoeffective theta, an actual original-carrier reference V_theta=P_theta(0), and divisorial compactness of the sup-zero cone. Thus general big-class envelopes and normalized psh compactness are already established in the full retained field domain, without countability, finite-generation, toric or support restrictions.

The pertinent proof was retained. For an actual big rational L and a PL obstacle on a resolved SNC test configuration, total-space base ideals a_m give same-L section potentials phi_model+(1/m)log|a_m| increasing in the divisibility ordering. Horizontal base loci are retained. Multiplier ideals b_m satisfy a_m⊂b_m and b_ml⊂b_m^l. A fixed sufficiently positive equivariant ample total bundle A makes (mL+A)⊗b_m globally generated. The corrected genuine potentials phi_model+(1/m)log|b_m|+(1/m)phi_A decrease, after making phi_A nonnegative, in actual classes L+A/m tending to L. Varying-class closure gives a genuine limit; section-envelope equality outside the augmented base locus and divisorial determination identify the original envelope. Decreasing big references yield V_theta for pseudoeffective theta, and BJ 5.11 supplies compactness. This proves no big relative-energy operator or equation. The addendum's Theorem B explicitly retains an AMPLE class.

Darvas–Xia–Zhang, arXiv:2302.02541v3, 17 July 2024, published CMH 100 (2025), 269–322, DOI 10.4171/CMH/586, Theorem 3.14 identifies compatible analytic test-curve PSH with genuine BJ PSH for pseudoeffective rational bundles on complex projective manifolds. Section 3.4 defines big analytic finite energy by I_NA(eta)=tau_plus+(1/V)∫(∫_X theta_eta_tau^n−V)d tau, with V the positive complex nonpluripolar volume; finite energy forces the terminal reference V_theta. Therefore absence of every big E1 definition must not be claimed. The inspected units do not establish the requested original-carrier non-Archimedean intersection operator and arbitrary-target inverse theorem over every retained k.

Dervan–Reboulet, arXiv:2603.25605v1, 26 March 2026, works on smooth COMPLEX projective varieties with big bundles. Definition 3.4 and Theorem 3.6 prescribe finite divisorial probability data through compatible test configurations and a big real total bundle, with coefficients b_i⟨L_total⟩^n·E_i/vol(L). The central multiplicities and restricted positive intersections remain explicit. Its displayed simplex proof was inspected. This finite model endpoint is not an arbitrary-support genuine E1 theorem. Source comments on nonuniqueness concern test configurations, not a disproved reference-preserving metric uniqueness theorem.

Mesquita-Piccione–Witt Nyström, arXiv:2509.09442v1, 11 September 2025, retains a Kähler GENERIC positivity class. Big total degeneration classes do not extend that theorem to every nonample big generic bundle. Its hypotheses and theorem statement were inspected; no full proof reading or deduction from it is claimed.

Evidence is retained in P16.5-argument.md Sections 1–2, external-premises.json, public-primary/, primary-units/ and source-extracts/. notes.detailedSummary: Section factorization and compactness prove actual all-point psh membership without assuming a corrected net decreases. An intrinsic original-carrier quotient energy and genuine local nonpluripolar products are constructed relative to the computed reference. Admissibility itself forces zero exceptional-fiber mass. The exact task-granted ample theorem then gives actual solutions and attainment. Original-carrier measure convergence is proved, not inferred solely from pushforward. Outer differentiation is established for pulled continuous quotient directions only; neither arbitrary big bundles nor every original continuous direction is covered.
notes.text:
Use the genuine cones and retained fields in n1, and the exact supplied ample theorem only on smooth ample auxiliary varieties. Let Y be smooth connected projective of dimension n≥2 over any retained k, p∈Y(k), pi:X=Bl_pY→Y, E≅P^(n−1), A an ACTUAL ample rational bundle, a∈Q_{>0}, and an actual bundle isomorphism L=pi*A+aE. Put H=pi*A, lambda=log|s_E| in the canonical reference, and sigma=a lambda.

Every rational bundle B on X uniquely decomposes as pi*C+bE: push its divisor to smooth Y, and the remainder is supported on the sole exceptional prime. Restriction to an exceptional line detects b. This also splits numerical classes continuously. For b≥0 and divisible m, H0(X,m(pi*C+bE))=s_E^(mb)pi*H0(Y,mC). Indeed O_E(jE)=O_E(−j) has no sections for j>0, so the divisor exact sequence removes E repeatedly. At j=0, pi_*O_X=O_Y: regular functions extend across the removed codimension-at-least-two point on normal Y by the height-one valuation-ring characterization. Consequently vol(L)=(A^n)=V>0. An exceptional line has L-degree −a, so L is nonnef; H has degree zero there and is not ample.

For any genuine phi∈PSH(X,L), choose its defining decreasing section net phi_i on actual B_i with c1(B_i)→c1(L). Write B_i=pi*C_i+b_iE, where b_i→a and C_i→A numerically. Eventually b_i>0. Literal section factorization gives phi_i=b_i lambda+pi*psi_i, where psi_i is genuine section-generated on C_i and sup psi_i=sup phi_i=c_i↓c=sup phi. Canonical global-section evaluation bounds psi_i≤c_i. Thus phi≤sigma+c, and phi=−∞ on E.

The psi_i need not decrease. Instead normalize them in PSH_sup(Y,2A), valid on a tail because 2A−C_i is ample, and extract an actual compactness subnet limit psi−c. For each rational 0<delta<1, a tail belongs to PSH_sup(Y,(1+delta)A), whose compact image is closed in the Hausdorff 2A-space. Hence psi belongs to every such cone. Constant-scalar varying-class closure as delta decreases to zero gives psi∈PSH(Y,A). At every common divisorial valuation v, lambda(v) is finite and psi_i(v)→phi(v)−a lambda(v). Genuine sigma+pi*psi and phi therefore agree on all divisorial valuations, hence at EVERY analytic point. Conversely genuine addition and pullback give membership. Thus
PSH(X,L)=sigma+pi*PSH(Y,A).
This is a homeomorphism in common divisorial coordinates and preserves suprema. All normalized phi are ≤sigma and sigma is feasible, so the intrinsic original reference V_L=P_L(0) equals sigma.

Define Qphi=pi*psi as the unique global genuine H-psh extension of phi−sigma from X\E. It is an actual function, not subtraction of two −∞ values on E. The actual section frame s_E identifies L with H on X\E; in this frame phi has the raw metric weight of Qphi. Its local intersection products are consequently genuine pulled ample products. For bounded quotients the nef intersection theorem on X gives positive raw products of mass H^n=V. Model projection and decreasing approximation give their genuine ample pushforwards.

Zero point mass is justified explicitly. A section of mA vanishing at p gives u=(1/m)log|s|−1≤−1. Set alpha=1/(n+2) and w=−(−u)^alpha. Convex composition, extended affinely from −1 to zero with slopes in [0,1], makes w genuine A-psh. The ample capacity estimate gives Cap{w≤−t}=O(t^(−1/alpha)); the energy bound integrates t^n times this tail. Since n−1/alpha=−2, the integral is finite. Thus w∈E1(Y,A) and w(p)=−∞. Every ample finite-energy mixed measure and every finite-dual-energy target integrates w, forcing zero p-mass. Only this conservative exponent is needed; the larger range printed in the retained source is not assumed.

For unbounded finite-energy quotients, retain the same genuine local products on O=X^an\E^an≅Y^an\{p}, and extend by ZERO on E. These are positive Radon measures, by compact approximation away from the zero-mass point. Call them M_sigma. Their pushforwards are the genuine ample mixed products, their exceptional mass is zero, and their RAW total mass is V=vol(L). This construction uses actual metric frames and local intersection products before identifying the global measure; it is not an alternative inverse measure assignment.

Define intrinsic relative energy on original X. Put q=Qphi, q_m=max(q,−m) in the NEF H cone, and phi_m=sigma+q_m in the ACTUAL L cone. Using genuine bounded H-products on X, set
E_sigma,raw(phi_m)=(1/(n+1))Σ_(j=0)^n ∫q_m M_H(q_m^j,0^(n−j)),
E_sigma,raw(phi)=lim_m E_sigma,raw(phi_m).
Actual intersection projection proves E_sigma,raw(phi)=E_A,raw(psi). Hence the actual relative finite-energy space is
E1(X,L;sigma)={genuine phi:E_sigma,raw(phi)>−∞}=sigma+pi*E1(Y,A).
It includes unbounded quotients, retains the fixed reference and movable datum H=L−aE, and is neither an abstract completion nor an unrelated ample-generated energy intersection. Energy is concave, monotone, weakly upper semicontinuous and decreasing-net continuous, has E(sigma)=0, and shifts by Vc under addition of c. Its mixed difference formula integrates Qphi−Qphi′ against the genuine M_sigma products with factor 1/(n+1); all integrals are finite by their ample counterparts.

Original-carrier weak convergence is proved explicitly. For decreasing genuine finite-energy nets, the corresponding ample measures nu_j converge to nu and nu(p)=0. Given F continuous on X, choose a continuous cutoff chi=1 near p with ∫chi dnu<epsilon. The function (1−chi)F∘pi^−1 extends continuously by zero to Y. Weak convergence handles it, while omitted integrals are bounded by ||F||∫chi dnu_j and become arbitrarily small. Thus the zero-extended products converge weakly on X, including for unbounded nets; pushforward convergence alone is not substituted.

For positive Radon mu on X of raw mass V, define
D_sigma(mu)=sup_(actual phi∈E1(X,L;sigma))[E_sigma,raw(phi)−∫Qphi dmu].
It equals E_A,raw^vee(pi_*mu). Finiteness is therefore equivalent to integrability of EVERY actual finite-energy quotient, and itself forces mu(E)=0. No extra support condition is silently imposed; support away from this intrinsically excluded locus can be arbitrary. Raw phi-integrability is not substituted for quotient-integrability, since sigma can have divergent integrals.

The granted ample theorem supplies an actual attained solution psi for nu=pi_*mu. Then phi=sigma+pi*psi is an actual original L-metric in the relative E1 space, and its objective is the attained ample objective. Its locally constructed measure and mu have the same pushforward and both vanish on E; the analytic isomorphism of the complements proves equality on original X. Maximizing sequences have bounded quotient J, actual compact limits, finite energy by lower semicontinuity, and attained objectives by target-integral continuity. Equal measures imply equal ample quotient measures and hence uniqueness modulo one real constant. Comparison transfers on O, and both measures vanish on E:
∫_{phi<phi′} MA_sigma(phi′)≤∫_{phi<phi′} MA_sigma(phi).
Strict-winning and mixed locality transfer through the actual local frame identity.

For g∈C0(Y), the relative outer energy of sigma+pi*(psi+tg) is the ample outer energy; its actual envelope is sigma+pi*P_A(psi+tg). Both derivative signs give dE/dt|0=∫pi*g MA_sigma,raw(phi). These tests identify all admissible measures because exceptional mass is zero. A full outer theorem for every nonpulled f∈C0(X) is NOT established. Nor is there a reduction of every big bundle to this single-point blowup domain. No novelty claim is made for the abstract fixed-part-removal principle.

The complete argument is in P16.5-argument.md Sections 3–5 and P16.5-paper.pdf. Rerun python3 rerun.py. This is a mathematical proof draft relative to the expressly granted ample theorem, not a complete original P16.5 solution.

notes.text:
From n2, on Bl_pY with H=pi*A and L=H+aE,
vol(L)=(A^n)=V,
L^n=V+(−1)^(n−1)a^n,
and L·ell=−a on an exceptional line.
Indeed H|E is numerically trivial, so all mixed H/E intersections vanish, while O_E(E)=O_E(−1) gives E^n=(−1)^(n−1). For Y=P2, A=O(1), a=1, the actual big nonnef L=H+E has L²=0, L·E=−1 and h0(mL)=binom(m+2,2), hence vol(L)=1. For a=2, L²=−3 but volume remains one. These are positive-volume examples. They show why a general big raw operator cannot simply retain mass L^n or an intersection-based probability division.

For a genuine zero-volume example, let X=P1×P1 over any retained k and L=pr1*O(1). It is an actual nef semiample nonample bundle, L²=0 and h0(mL)=m+1, hence vol(L)=0. Pull back generators s0,s1 from the first factor. Canonical generating evaluation gives max(log|s0|,log|s1|)=0 everywhere. For b>0 set
u_b=max(log|s0|,log|s1|+b)−b.
Both u_b and zero are bounded genuine L-psh potentials, with −b≤u_b≤0 and supremum zero. For D={s1=0}×P1,
u_b(v_triv)=0,
u_b(t ord_D)=max(0,b−t)−b=−b when t≥b.
Thus they do not differ by a constant.

These top measures are genuine intersection measures in an established domain. B=O(1,1) is ample and B−L is nef, so both bounded potentials are finite-energy B-psh and belong to BJ's ambient finite-energy vector space. BJ 7.18–7.19 supplies positivity for the NEF L-metrics and raw mass L²=0. A positive measure of mass zero is zero. Therefore
(c1(L)+ddc u_b)^2=(c1(L)+ddc 0)^2=0.
The unchanged zero top operator is not injective modulo constants in this actual cone. Zero-mass probability normalization is undefined. This is not a counterexample to a properly specified lower-degree mixed or quotient replacement theory, none of which is generally constructed here.

The additional zero-volume equation range actually proved is the ACTUAL TRIVIAL bundle O_X on smooth connected projective X of dimension n≥1 over the retained fields. BJ Corollary 4.24 gives PSH(0)=constants. One direct argument: each zero-psh phi is epsilon B-psh for every epsilon>0 and fixed ample B. At a divisorial v,
0≤sup phi−phi(v)≤epsilon T_B(v).
Let epsilon decrease to zero and use divisorial determination. Choose reference zero and raw energy E_raw(c)=0 on actual finite constant metrics. Their genuine top product is zero, of raw mass zero. The sole positive Radon target of mass zero is mu=0, its dual energy is sup_c(0−∫c d0)=0, and every constant attains the objective. Uniqueness modulo constants holds because the quotient cone is a point. No probability measure is introduced. Dimension zero is excluded because its empty product has mass one.

The canonical mathematical outcome is INCOMPLETE original P16.5, using n1–n3. Published results establish the full retained smooth pseudoeffective psh cone, V_L, envelopes and normalized compactness. This draft proves only the explicit nonnef fixed-part equation endpoint, with its stated differentiation restriction, plus the separate mass obstructions and actual trivial-bundle zero equation. It does not claim a full big rational-line-bundle theorem or unrestricted zero-volume theory.

The precise unproved gates are:
G1. For every actual big rational L, construct model-independent positive raw relative nonpluripolar products and an actual original-carrier E1 space retaining intrinsic V_L or an explicitly proved reference type; establish volume/relative mass and genuine unbounded decreasing limits.
G2. Prove full relative mixed-energy estimates, weighted continuity, locality, comparison/domination and two-sided outer differentiation for EVERY continuous original-carrier direction, with reference-preserving orthogonality.
G3. Prove intrinsic target integrability equivalence, coercivity and target-integral continuity; obtain an actual finite-relative-energy attained maximizer, identify its genuine original measure using both derivative signs, and prove uniqueness modulo constants.
G4. Establish these conclusions over every retained field and for arbitrary admissible support, without replacing the whole domain by complex test curves, finite divisorial models, finite generation or a fixed ample contraction.
G5. On further zero-volume pseudoeffective classes construct and prove an explicit replacement datum/operator with its original carrier, auxiliary polarization if used, reference quotient, raw mass, admissibility and injectivity mechanism. The zero top equation cannot give blanket uniqueness in a nonconstant cone.
